sentences: Spectral hypergraphs can serve as combinatorial building blocks for error-correcting codes and small-bias distributions.
The source asks for explicit regular three-uniform hypergraph families approaching its nearly Ramanujan spectral target.
The family must be sufficiently dense in its available sizes for the downstream constructions.
The stored formula has extraction damage, so the original definition of the spectral parameter governs the exact bound.
The project seeks deterministic structured objects that could replace random choices in efficient coding constructions.
